PROBLEM STATEMENT AND PROPOSED SOLUTION

Problem Statement
Existing fitness apps lack:
• No personalized goal-based plans
• No integrated progress tracking
• No AI-powered fitness guidance
• No community motivation features

Proposed Solution
• Goal-based personalized diet & exercise plans
• JWT secure authentication system
• Real-time dashboard & progress analytics
• AI assistant with voice support
• Social community forum for motivation
Project Objective
Build a full-stack Fitness Maintenance Portal that helps users achieve personal health goals through personalized diet & exercise plans, real-time progress tracking, AI-powered guidance, and community engagement.
